SMTO-CAP-0012 — SMTO asked for a part of a Skill that isn't listed

GUID: 4db21fbe-6944-4bcf-837f-95d698d869c5
Slug: tool-api-section-unknown
Domain: CAP · Subsystem: cap

What happened

  • SMTO's Agent asked to see a section of a Skill's tools that this SMTO doesn't list, often a guessed or outdated name. Nothing was run, and the Agent can look up the real sections and continue.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Watch the Task. If it keeps working after this message, you don't need to do anything. SMTO points the Agent back to the Skill's real list of sections, so it can correct itself.
  2. If you recently updated a user Skill, open User Skills and check that it shows Ready to select. An updated Skill can rename or drop sections the Agent learned about earlier.
  3. Open Capabilities by the message box, select Refresh catalog, then ask SMTO to continue the Task. The Agent then works from the Skill's current sections instead of the old name.

What success looks like

  • The Task finds the right section and keeps working without this message.

If it still fails

  • Send Copy error details to the person who manages SMTO; they include the section name that was asked for. Don't keep sending the same request unchanged, because it will look for the same missing section.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Section lookup in the selected Skill's registered API tree returned no match for the requested section_id (Unknown API section); no tools were advertised or executed.

What this means

  • Section lookup within the registered skill API returned no match for the selected section identity. Capability discovery and registration describe what this run may request. They do not grant operating-system permission, override exclusions or authorize execution by themselves.

Why this can happen

  • Section lookup within the registered skill API returned no match for the selected section identity.

How to diagnose it

  • Read the selected skill's section tree and compare the exact requested section ID.

How to fix it

  • Call discover_tools with the Skill ID to list its current sections and child_section_ids, then request an exact listed section (ToolCatalog._discover in src/agent_runtime/native/catalog.py). If the Skill's API tree changed, update or reinstall the Skill so its sections match what callers expect.
  • Discover the registered skill and choose one of its listed API sections.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • An existing section returns its current allowed tool declarations.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Capability discovery and registration describe what this run may request. They do not grant operating-system permission, override exclusions or authorize execution by themselves.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
